 Home » Entertainment »  Television Rohit Eliminated From Bigg Boss Telugu 10
 Television DC Correspondent 2 Nov 2026 10:19 AM IST 2 Nov 2026 10:19 AM IST Fans are disappointed with his elimination and are demanding his re-entry into the house.
 x Rohit Naidu. As Preferred
Source In a surprising twist, the show organisers of Bigg Boss Telugu have eliminated popular contestant Rohit. It was a very unexpected elimination; neither fans nor the audience had guessed Rohit’s eviction. 
 Rohit’s elimination came as a huge shock to the viewers. He was eliminated through the housemates' decision rather than by audience votes. 
 Fans are disappointed with his elimination and are demanding his re-entry into the house. 
 Whether the makers will hear the plea of the audience remains to be seen.
